name: Garmin LIDAR-Lite v3HP
description: Single-point 905 nm laser rangefinder, 40 m range at >1 kHz, I²C/PWM, in an IPX7 housing.

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: ±5 cm typ. < 2 m (non-linear below 1 m); ±2.5 cm typ. ≥ 2 m

specs.label: Update rate
specs.value: >1 kHz typical (reduced sensitivity at high rates)

specs.label: Laser
specs.value: 905 nm, 1.3 W peak, Class 1 (EN/IEC 60825-1:2014); beam 12 × 2 mm at aperture, 8 mrad divergence

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: I²C fast mode 400 kb/s (addr 0x62), PWM (10 µs/cm), external trigger

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 5 V nominal (4.5–5.5 V), 65 mA idle / 85 mA acquiring; 680 µF capacitor recommended

specs.label: Weight / protection
specs.value: 38 g; IEC 60529 IPX7 (bare-wire end not sealed)

envelope.axes: x = width across both optics and mounting ears, y = height, z = depth along the optical axis (Garmin lists L × W × H = 40.18 × 54.99 × 35)

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 4 ear holes on a 36 mm (horizontal) × 32 mm (vertical) rectangle, centred on the body; item 7 = 4 mm is the callout at the lower-left ear (likely the hole diameter — confirm on a part).
features.source: LIDAR-Lite v3HP Operation Manual (April 2020) 'Device Dimensions' p.1–2, items 2, 5, 7

features.label: Optics
features.value: Two optics (transmit/receive) 27.69 mm apart centre-to-centre; item 8 = 14.65 mm callout at the left lens (likely optic diameter); optical axis 16 mm from the top-hole row (item 4).

features.label: Depth
features.value: 35 mm overall depth (item 9); rear section 13.1 mm (item 10) behind the mounting flange; harness exits the bottom.

notes: Garmin's drawing is a numbered legend (items 1–10) without feature labels; the hole-diameter (4 mm) and optic-diameter (14.65 mm) readings are inferred from where the callouts point and should be checked.
